title: Goku Yelling (Power Up)
blurb: Twenty seconds of sustained effort before anything actually happens: commitment as content. Dragon Ball Z turned the power-up scream into a genre convention of its own, with the ground cracking, the hair changing colour and an entire episode going by, and this is the purest example of the form. Applied to ordinary tasks that demand more will than they should, it becomes genuinely funny. Play it while opening a jar, waiting for a download to reach ninety-nine per cent, or summoning the resolve to answer an email from a fortnight ago. The power level is rising, eventually.
origin: Goku's iconic power-up scream from Dragon Ball Z.
